title: "link_unavailable"
description: "A link could not be made or read: the target is unreachable or has no role/view for the linking actor."

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** A link could not be made or read: the target is unreachable or has no role/view for the linking actor.

**How to fix it:** Make sure the target actor exists, gives the linking actor (a service caller) a role, and its view is an object.

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
